description: Canvas Bar Chart by DataFactZ is a premium, enterprise-grade bar chart visual for Microsoft Power BI. Designed for analysts and report authors who need more than the default bar chart, it combines modern design, deep customization, and powerful interactivity in a single visual. From simple column charts to multi-series stacked layouts, independent Y-axis scales per series, and lollipop-style KPI charts with custom icons or images — Canvas Bar Chart delivers pixel-level control directly from the Format Pane. Chart Types - Stacked Bars — Stack multiple measures within each category for part-to-whole analysis. - Clustered Bars — Display measures side by side for easy series comparison. - Multi-Axis Stacked & Clustered — Assign independent Y-axis scales per series, perfect for comparing measures with vastly different ranges on the same chart. Key Features - Rich Bar Styling — Adjustable corner radius, bar spacing, per-series gradient fills, transparency control, custom borders, and drop shadows for a premium look. - Track Bar (Target Line) — Overlay a reference bar behind each category to visualize goals, quotas, or benchmarks. Supports dynamic per-category targets or a static global target. - Lollipop Markers — Place a value label, predefined icon (star, checkmark, arrow), or custom image at the tip of each bar. Per-category images via a dedicated Image URL data role. -…
